title: Railway feature section
description: A long-form product feature section: a tinted badge, a two-line book-serif title, a grey lead with a link, a product shot, three icon points and an "instead of" row. Stacked (wide near-black window below the text, points in three columns) or split (text and a hairline-divided list beside a tall card with a coloured glow rising from the bottom), optionally inside a framed tinted panel. On desktops a rail runs down the left edge: a station ring pulses beside the badge and a car slides down the track as the section scrolls.
notes: stack several and alternate framed (panel) and open ones, as the original does; the rails line up into one track
media is a slot; empty ones show a near-black window, a raised card or a tone-tinted card of the original's size
CSS only: the car rides a view() timeline; the station pulse is a 3s loop; both are off with reduced motion
the rail shows from lg up; phones get the plain stacked layout
